articles.title: Alvarez’s Rocket Launches Argentina Past Switzerland in World Cup Thriller
articles.summary: Julian Alvarez blasted a 25-yard rocket in extra time to send Argentina past Switzerland 3-1. Now the defending champs face England in the semifinals on Wednesday in Atlanta.

articles.title: Bellingham’s Extra-Time Heroics Send England Past Norway in a Scorcher
articles.summary: Jude Bellingham scored in the 93rd minute to lift England over Norway 2-1 in a sweltering World Cup quarterfinal. England now faces Argentina in the semifinals on Wednesday in Atlanta.

articles.title: Famous Guggenheim Museum Caught Up in NYC Legionnaires’ Outbreak
articles.summary: The Guggenheim Museum is one of 31 buildings in Manhattan that tested positive for Legionella bacteria. Over 50 people have been diagnosed, but no deaths are reported, and the museum has already cleaned its cooling towers.
